description: List the open calls Gondar has matched to the signed-in workspace's profile, best fit first, with each call's score.

language.description: Language for translated titles. Without it, titles stay in the source language.

region.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes, or EU, UK or GLOBAL. A country lists its own calls; add EU for EU-wide programmes.

type.description: Only this kind of call. Without it, every kind.
